Bill.BriefDescription: Simplifying procedures for obtaining an order for refund of property taxes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to property tax assessment administration,simplifying procedures for obtaining an order for refund; and amendingRCW 84.69.030.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 84.69.030 and 2009 c 350 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in this section, no orders for a refundunder this chapter ((shall)) may be made except on a claim: (((1))) (a) Verified by the person who paid the tax, the person'sguardian, executor or administrator; and (((2))) (b) Filed with the county treasurer within three yearsafter the due date of the payment sought to be refunded; and (((3))) (c) Stating the statutory ground upon which the refund isclaimed. (2) No claim for an order of refund is required for a refund thatis based upon: (a) An order of the board of equalization, state board of taxappeals, or court of competent jurisdiction justifying a refund underRCW 84.69.020 (9) through (12); p. 1 HB 2446 (b) A decision by the treasurer or assessor that is rendered withinthree years after the due date of the payment to be refunded,justifying a refund under RCW 84.69.020; or (c) A decision by the assessor or department approving an exemptionapplication that is filed under chapter 84.36 RCW within three yearsafter the due date of the payment to be refunded.
